subtitle: Adds WASD movement to Minecraft Dungeons II, and removes click to move!
description:
WASD moves your character relative to the camera, and your character turns smoothly to face the way you are walking. Clicking no longer moves you. Clicking attacks towards the enemy highlighted in red, like the game does without the mod, or towards your cursor when nothing is highlighted. Clicking while jumping does a ground slam the same way.

The movement keys can be changed in the Mods tab of the game's settings, so you can move with any keys you like, such as the arrow keys or ESDF. Melee Aim Assist can be turned off there too, so clicking always attacks towards your cursor.

S opens the multiplayer wheel by default, so if you keep WASD you will want to rebind it in the game's controls settings.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the WASDControls folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\WASDControls\WASDControls_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the WASDControls folder from ~mods.
